description: This file defines the application configuration for an Angular project, setting up providers for routing, zone change detection, and client hydration.

methods.name: provideZoneChangeDetection
methods.description: Configures zone change detection strategy, including event coalescing.

methods.name: provideRouter
methods.description: Provides routing configuration based on the imported routes.

methods.name: provideClientHydration
methods.description: Sets up client-side hydration with optional event replay.

methods.name: withEventReplay
methods.description: Enables event replay for hydration purposes.
